premises.text: Businesses use custom currency like gift cards and promo codes for targeted marketing.
premises.evidence_span: big businesses have figured out that they can use custom currency in their targeted marketing to get you to their site and compel you to spend.

premises.text: Enabling custom currency is complicated and requires tracking user interactions.
premises.evidence_span: enabling custom currency is actually really hard to do. It's complicated, and payment systems aren't set up to do it well.

premises.text: GiftBit provides a software-as-a-service platform for businesses to manage their custom currency.
premises.evidence_span: GiftBit has built a software-as-a-service platform to solve this problem.

premises.text: GiftBit integrates easily with merchant checkouts through a simple API.
premises.evidence_span: GiftBit integrates easily with a merchant's checkout through a simple API integration.

premises.text: Businesses can track their custom currency and promotional value through GiftBit.
premises.evidence_span: Chris is able to see all his business's custom currency, their gift cards, their refund credits, and their promotional value.

premises.text: GiftBit helps businesses incentivize customers to return and spend their gift cards.
premises.evidence_span: Socks in the Box is actually able to incentivize Rita to come back to their site and spend that money.

premises.text: GiftBit's pricing model makes it accessible to businesses of any size.
premises.evidence_span: $90 a month gets you 1,000 active codes.

value.text: Businesses can effectively manage and utilize custom currency to drive sales.
value.evidence_span: no one needs to build their own complicated custom currency because they have GiftBit.
